claims.exact_statement: Independent reconstruction accepts B05-A023-SHARED-SWITCH-U-IDENTITY-v1 for all finite-dimensional genuine Boolean g,h on the same physical variables and every fresh d-bit one-word selector, including all coherent, difference-packet, and explicit selector-depth terms.
limitations: Identity only; no universal bound for arbitrary overlap follows.

claims.exact_statement: Independent reconstruction accepts B05-A023-BENT-ONEPOINT-OVERLAP-PAYMENT-v1: for every even k>=8, every bent Boolean g on k bits, every one-point flip h, and every fresh selector depth d>=1, U(F)-(1-p)U(g)-pU(h)<=71 I_ctl(F), where p=2^-d and I_ctl(F)=2pd2^-k.
claims.first_unproved_line: Control nonreused coherent cap interaction across two or more changing shared-core surgeries.
